SELECT cr.relics_id, cr.relics_name, cr.era, rt.type_name, cr.created_at FROM cultural_relics cr LEFT JOIN relics_type rt ON cr.relics_type_id = rt.relics_type_id AND rt.is_deleted = 0 WHERE cr.is_deleted = 0
AND cr.era LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.era}, '%')
AND cr.relics_type_id = #{query.relicsTypeId}
ORDER BY cr.created_at DESC

SELECT cr.relics_id, cr.relics_name, cr.era, rt.type_name, cr.created_at FROM cultural_relics cr LEFT JOIN relics_type rt ON cr.relics_type_id = rt.relics_type_id AND rt.is_deleted = 0 WHERE cr.is_deleted = 0
AND (
cr.relics_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{tk}, '%') OR rt.type_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{tk}, '%') OR cr.era LIKE CONCAT('%', #{tk}, '%')
)
ORDER BY cr.created_at DESC

SELECT cr.relics_id, cr.relics_name, cr.era, rt.type_name, cr.created_at FROM cultural_relics cr LEFT JOIN relics_type rt ON cr.relics_type_id = rt.relics_type_id AND rt.is_deleted = 0 WHERE cr.is_deleted = 0 AND cr.relics_name = #{name} ORDER BY cr.created_at DESC
